📝 How to Register

1️⃣ Select Your Participation

Join the Merdeka X Malaysia Challenge and complete the weekly challenges individually. ZUS Moments activities are optional.

2️⃣ Fill in Your Details

For all participants: Base → ZUS ID → Lark Profile → Department / Outlet.

3️⃣ Access the Tracker

Once registered, use the Lark Base Tracker to follow your challenge progress and points.

📝 Open Registration Form ↗

📌 Submission Guidelines

🗓️ Submit Weekly

Complete and submit each weekly challenge separately through the Lark Base Tracker within its applicable challenge period.

🚫 No Combined Submission

Week 1, Week 2 and Week 3 submissions cannot be combined and submitted at the end of the challenge.

📸 ZUS Moments

Posting is optional but can earn up to 15 bonus points per week for valid weekly submissions.

🏆 Leaderboard & Prizes

🥇 Top 5 Winners

Participants with the highest final accumulated points will be the winners.

RM50 Grab / TNG eWallet voucher

One RM50 voucher for each winner.

📈 Ranking

Higher total points = higher ranking.

If participants have the same points, earlier submission takes priority.

📅 Winner Announcement

Winners will be announced on 23 September 2026.

Challenge Progression: Register → Week 1 Challenge → Week 1 Results → Week 2 Challenge → Top 69 Advance → Week 3 Challenge → Top 5 Winners

❓ FAQ

Where do I submit my challenge proof?

Use the designated submission method stated in the weekly challenge instructions and ensure your submission is completed within the required period.

How do I check my points?

Use the Lark Base Tracker button above to view your recorded progress.

Can I earn more than the weekly maximum?

No. Each activity has a defined point cap. Additional submissions beyond the applicable cap do not create additional points.

What happens if my submission is not valid?

It may be rejected or excluded from the point calculation if it does not meet the stated challenge requirements.
